info.name: Cox's Bazaar ERP - API Collection
info.description:
Postman API Collection for testing all sections of Cox's Bazaar Distribution ERP (Customers, Suppliers, Products, Brands, Categories, Units, Transfers, Adjustments, Sales, Purchases, Users, etc.).

### How to Use:
1. Import this file into Postman.
2. Ensure the collection variable `base_url` is set to your local server (default: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`).
3. Run **Authentication > 1. Get CSRF Cookie** first.
4. Run **Authentication > 2. Login** (uses demo superadmin credentials).
5. Test any endpoint in the collection! Session cookies and CSRF tokens are handled automatically.
